status: author-proposed survey guidance; no experimental observations
scope_note: Operational recommendations for future evaluations; not original-study metric normalization or a validated standard. Report raw counts, uncertainty, missing outcomes and aggregation. Zero denominators are undefined.

metrics.numerator: Trials satisfying the predeclared attacker goal
metrics.qualification: Goal/judge, access, retries and utility; report aborted or unevaluable trials separately

metrics.numerator: Attempted legitimate tasks completed within the stated authorization policy
metrics.qualification: Clean/attacked/defended conditions, quality criteria, cost and attacker success

metrics.numerator: Attack trials with at least one released action violating the independent physical oracle
metrics.qualification: Released does not mean executed; pair with completion, abort accounting and checker mismatch

metrics.numerator: Executed actions violating the independent physical oracle
metrics.qualification: Conditional on execution; blocking changes denominator; report volume and unsafe release per trial
Independent oracle, proposal sampling and safe-proposal false blocks

metrics.numerator: Oracle-safe and policy-authorized proposals blocked by the defense
metrics.denominator: All proposals satisfying both physical safety and authorization policy
metrics.qualification: Safe but unauthorized proposals must remain blocked; pair with completion and latency

metrics.numerator: Member records classified as members at a threshold with declared false-positive rate
metrics.denominator: All evaluated member records; separately report false positives over evaluated nonmember records
metrics.qualification: Report threshold, sampling, query budget, retrieval versus training membership and utility; AUC alone is insufficient

metrics.numerator: Disclosure trials exposing at least one predeclared protected item
metrics.qualification: Report number/sensitivity of exposed items, extraction judge, rules and budget; membership is not extraction
